name: Mercenary Ice Barrier
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Ice Barrier (players/sorcerer/mercenary/ice_barrier_merc.sval, 16 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 4 (in brackets): reduction 33% (50%). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Casting a skill adds a 2.5 s barrier that cuts one hit's damage by 33%; up to 8 barriers.
